Gastrointestinal Stromal Tumor (GIST): Histopathological analysis: densely crowded spindle and polygonal cell tumour
Tumour spread: into the mucosa and outwards into the serosa
Immunohistochemistry: negative staining for broad range cytokeratins (MNF 116), CD34, desmin, S-100 and chromogranin
Symptom exacerbation: symptoms worsened after heavy meals
moderate nuclear pleomorphism in spindle and polygonal cells
tumor spread into mucosa and serosa
